transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Sunday, October 18. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. 'There is pressure on us': Pakistan's ICC trophy drought adds to players' burden. Pakistan last reached the final of an ICC tournament at the 2022 T20 World Cup in Australia, where they lost to England in Melbourne. Texas tenants win damages and legal fees after landlord keeps $2,600 deposit. In a recent Texas court case, a landlord's attempt to retain a couple's security deposit, along with demands for extra payments post-move-out, was contested. The tenants triumphed, though the court adjusted some damage estimates. Texas statutes mandate landlords to avoid withholding deposits for usual wear and tear and to furnish detailed deductions. The ruling underlines the necessity for landlords to adhere to security deposit regulations strictly. Crowd, rain or misleading announcement: What led to Kolkata stampede tragedy?. A sudden surge of people, heavy rain and alleged confusion over announcements and entry-exit routes are among the factors being investigated after a stampede at the Chorbagan Sarbojanin Durga Puja pandal in Kolkata killed at least 19 people and injured 25 others on Saturday evening. 12 killed after speeding truck runs over devotees near temple in Gwalior. 12 people were killed and several others injured after a speeding truck ran over devotees travelling to the Sheetla Mata Temple in Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, early Sunday. 'I found my wife lying still': Husband's heartbreaking account of Kolkata stampede. My wife and I arrived in Kolkata from Chakdah at around 1 pm and headed straight to Santosh Mitra Square. Chris Woakes autobiography: Former England seamer slams Rob Key over 'shabby' exit. Woakes, who played 217 international matches for England across formats, including 62 Tests, made his final red-ball appearance during the fifth Test against India at The Oval in August 2025. Despite dislocating his shoulder while fielding, he came out to bat in a bid to help his team. Wyoming landowner rejects $3,600-an-acre offer; $80m reservoir may use eminent domain. In Wyoming, the Alkali Creek Reservoir project encounters significant hurdles as landowners resist easement agreements. Local landowner Paul Hughes has rejected an offer of $3,600 per acre, leading to discussions about eminent domain. While the project seeks to supply irrigation water to families, concerns about equitable benefit sharing arise, with landowners feeling they will endure construction impacts without receiving direct advantages. Jamnagar on Rubio's two-day itinerary: Musk mellows on Reliance, 'appreciates' post. Elon Musk's blow-hot-and-cold stand for getting Starlink access to India has now entered a conciliatory phase after the tech trillionaire was all fire on X last week. Brad Paisley and wife help open free Nashville grocery store with $1m gift. Brad Paisley and Kimberly Williams-Paisley have expanded their philanthropic efforts by launching a second location of The Store, a nonprofit grocery aimed at combating food insecurity in Nashville. Following their first store's success in 2020, which garnered over 3,100 dedicated volunteers, the couple has invested $1 million into this new initiative to ensure families receive dignified access to food choices and additional resources. USCIS: Anyone who 'guarantees' a faster visa or Green Card is scamming you. USCIS warns immigrants and visa applicants about fraudulent schemes that promise quicker visa approvals in exchange for monetary fees. These scams frequently involve false claims of having special ties to government officials. USCIS insists that no one can hasten the immigration process through personal connections. Individuals should file applications independently and trust assistance only from recognized professionals.
